description.value: Tin Whistle is a craft brewery and taproom set inside the historic Cannery Trade Centre, a former fruit cannery turned industrial-chic gathering space in Penticton. It holds the distinction of being the first carbon neutral brewery in British Columbia, a milestone the company announced on Earth Day 2021. The taproom pours a rotating lineup of South Okanagan-inspired beers — including their iconic Peach Cream Ale and experimental seasonal taps — in a setting the brewery describes as always playing records and always pouring something new.
